tools.name: get_app_status
tools.description: Read Desktop version/platform, downloader readiness, extension connection and queue status.

tools.name: get_settings
tools.description: Read public Desktop preferences. API keys, cookie contents and proxy credentials are never returned.

tools.name: update_settings
tools.description: Patch declared Desktop preferences, including download/subtitle defaults, language/theme, concurrency and ASR tier. Unspecified fields are preserved. Paths must be absolute; the ASR tier must be installed.

tools.name: get_ai_settings
tools.description: Read configured AI providers and saved prompts without API keys or embedded endpoint credentials.

tools.name: manage_ai_settings
tools.description: Manage provider models/capabilities, select or test saved providers, inspect/select Cloud models, and save/delete/restore prompts. Reuse saved keys through copyApiKeyFromId; configure new secrets inside Desktop Settings.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List downloads, conversions, transcription and model tasks. Follow nextCursor with the same filters.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Read one task, local output paths, progress, retry state, child tasks and sanitized failure logs.

tools.name: get_queue_stats
tools.description: Read task counts, execution capacity and running tasks per group.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Queue video/audio from url, convert/trim/resize a completed parentId, transcribe parentId, or download an asrTier. Returns admission; poll get_task for completion. Formats and containers use saved preferences when omitted.

background.description: Skip automatic completion waiting only when the user explicitly requests admission-only background work.

tools.name: download_media
tools.description: Queue video, audio, or subtitles only. Use type: subtitles with optional language and format: srt (default) or vtt to fetch existing website captions without media or ASR. Captions appear in the library and transcript detail; use the returned task ID as get_transcript.downloadId. Subtitle mode also accepts title and customDownloadPath. Video/audio support format selection, audio tracks, clipping, filenames, folders, tags and subtitle settings. Saved preferences and credentials are reused. Returns admission; poll get_task for completion and output.filePath.

language.description: Select one caption language when type is subtitles.

tools.name: download_batch
tools.description: Queue up to 50 media URLs serially with common options. Each result reports admission or error independently; duplicate downloads are reused.

language.description: Select one caption language when type is subtitles.

tools.name: manage_task
tools.description: Pause, resume, cancel, retry, remove history, rename title, or rename a completed media file. Inspect get_task before retrying. remove retains physical files; name is required for renames.

tools.name: configure_queue_group
tools.description: Set a per-group concurrency limit (1–64); null restores the shared default. Global limits are available through update_settings.

tools.name: inspect_media_engine
tools.description: Inspect yt-dlp/FFmpeg, paginate URL formats or playlist entries, probe a completed local task, or update/repair yt-dlp. No shell commands or arbitrary flags are accepted.

tools.name: list_download_history
tools.description: Search persisted media history by ID/title/URL, with optional status. Logs and execution commands are omitted; local paths are included.

tools.name: list_subscriptions
tools.description: Search subscriptions by ID/title/feed URL. Results omit item bodies and include refresh errors; follow nextOffset.

tools.name: get_subscription
tools.description: Read one saved subscription and its configuration.

tools.name: test_subscription
tools.description: Resolve and fetch an RSS/Atom, website or supported channel URL without saving or downloading. Returns evidence and corrected feed URLs when discovered.

tools.name: create_subscription
tools.description: Validate a feed then save a subscription. autoDownload defaults false; enable it explicitly for automatic downloads.

tools.name: update_subscription
tools.description: Patch a subscription; omitted preferences are retained and changed URLs are fetched before saving.

tools.name: remove_subscription
tools.description: Remove a subscription and cancel its outstanding tasks. Completed media files are retained.

tools.name: refresh_subscription
tools.description: Fetch a subscription now. May queue new items when its saved autoDownload preference is enabled.

tools.name: list_subscription_items
tools.description: Read paginated feed entries and download status for one subscription.

tools.name: queue_subscription_item
tools.description: Queue one existing feed entry using the subscription download preferences. Returns its task ID.

tools.name: list_transcripts
tools.description: List transcript states and available caption/ASR sources. Query matches source ID or title; follow nextOffset.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Read paginated selected caption/ASR segments, speakers, source choices and timestamps. Optional query/time range filters and word timestamps. Follow nextOffset to read all text.

tools.name: import_media
tools.description: Import existing local audio/video files into the library for transcription. Paths must be absolute. Returns accepted items and explicit rejections; no file dialog is opened.

tools.name: start_transcription
tools.description: Queue local transcription for a completed media download/import. force regenerates existing ASR; speakerCount can pin diarization. Returns admission; poll get_transcript for state.

tools.name: manage_transcription
tools.description: Retry/cancel transcription, rediarize speakers, switch caption/ASR source, or upgrade the ASR tier and retranscribe. key, speakerCount or tier is required for the respective action.

tools.name: update_transcript_segment
tools.description: Edit a selected transcript segment text, timing or speaker. Reads and edits use the same selected source as Desktop.

tools.name: insert_transcript_segment
tools.description: Insert a caption before/after an existing segment or at a timestamp. Returns the new segment ID.

tools.name: delete_transcript_segments
tools.description: Delete explicitly identified captions from the selected source.

tools.name: export_transcript
tools.description: Export the selected transcript using the detail page styles (transcript, subtitles, speaker segments, whisper), word/sentence grouping and timestamp option. Return paginated TXT/Markdown/SRT/VTT/JSON, or save the complete output to library/Exports with saveToFile=true. No dialogs or overwrites.

tools.name: export_subtitled_video
tools.description: Export a completed local video with the selected transcript: soft muxes selectable subtitles into MKV; hard burns captions into MP4. Writes a unique file in the library Exports folder without dialogs. Wait for the result; concurrent exports are rejected.

tools.name: manage_asr_model
tools.description: Inspect installed tiers; queue a model download; select a ready tier; or delete an inactive tier. Monitor model downloads with task tools.

tools.name: list_agent_threads
tools.description: Search persistent AI conversations, optionally restricted to a media ID. Follow nextOffset.

tools.name: get_agent_thread
tools.description: Read a conversation status, pending approvals, artifacts and paginated selected-branch messages. Long message text can be read with get_agent_message.

tools.name: get_agent_message
tools.description: Read a long conversation message in character pages, optionally including model thinking.

tools.name: create_agent_thread
tools.description: Create a blank AI conversation attached to an existing media task. Sending a message starts the model run.

tools.name: send_agent_message
tools.description: Send a message to a saved conversation using the configured AI provider. Returns immediately; poll get_agent_thread. Saved transcript context is loaded by Desktop.

tools.name: manage_agent_thread
tools.description: Stop a model run, rename/delete a conversation, or restore a reply branch. title is required for rename; messageId for select_branch.

tools.name: decide_agent_tool
tools.description: Approve or reject one pending tool call in the built-in Agent. Inspect its approval in get_agent_thread first; remember defaults false.

tools.name: get_agent_events
tools.description: Recover up to 50 committed conversation events after a sequence number. Follow nextAfter when hasMore is true.

tools.name: start_ai_prompt
tools.description: Run a saved AI prompt/skill on the selected stored transcript with the configured provider. Returns admission; read get_ai_prompt_run for streamed output.

tools.name: get_ai_prompt_run
tools.description: Read a saved skill run status/error and paginated generated text.

tools.name: stop_ai_prompt
tools.description: Cancel the identified AI prompt/skill run without stopping other conversations.

tools.name: list_skill_results
tools.description: Discover saved one-shot skills and assistant replies on a media item. Results include selectors, completion status and available export formats. New/custom skills are supported automatically.

tools.name: export_skill_result
tools.description: Export one assistant reply as Markdown, PDF or a branded PNG share image. Requires threadId and an optional messageId from an agent_reply in list_skill_results. downloadId+promptId skill records are not exportable: their screenshots are text placeholders. Embedded screenshots, source links and attribution match Desktop. PNG supports long posters or paginated images. Writes unique files under library/Exports; opens no dialogs or foreground windows.

tools.name: export_mermaid_diagram
tools.description: Export one Mermaid diagram from a completed assistant reply as PNG (default), JPG, SVG or MMD source. Requires threadId; messageId defaults to the latest non-empty reply in the selected branch. diagramIndex is zero-based in Markdown display order, including lists and blockquotes. theme defaults to Desktop's current light/dark theme. Renders with the same Pele plugin and raster exporter as Streamdown; raster edges are capped at 4096 pixels. Returns the saved path, bytes, diagram count and image dimensions. Writes a unique file under library/Exports using a private hidden window, with cancellation and no dialogs or clipboard access.

tools.name: export_caption_share_image
tools.description: Export selected stored caption segments as the same branded quote image used on the transcript detail page. Supply owned segment IDs. Supports long or paginated PNG images and never opens a share sheet or touches the clipboard.
